nom: Dr Dennis Gross Alpha Beta Universal Daily Peel: for Uneven Tone or Texture and Fine Lines or Enlarged Pores

avis.texte: I try out a lot of different beauty products. The majority of them are "meh" and wind up shoved to the back of my bathroom drawer. This is a rare product for me in that I have purchased it many times and have gifted to others. It really works well. It's easy to use and I do it once a week on what I call my "self care friday". It leaves your skin feeling and looking refreshed for days after use. My skin is somewhat sensitive and this doesn't irritate at all. Pricey though.

avis.titre: Amazing results, but it should definitely come with more product for the price!
avis.texte: There is no denying that the Dr. Dennis Gross Alpha Beta Universal Daily Peel Wipes are an excellent skincare product. After using them, my skin texture is noticeably smoother, my pores look smaller, and it gives me an instant, healthy glow. The two-step chemical peel system is incredibly effective and easy to use without causing any harsh irritation. However, my biggest complaint is the price point. For how expensive these are, I really think you should get more product in the box. Using them daily as recommended adds up fast, making it a pretty heavy investment for a monthly skincare routine. Overall, it’s a high-quality product that delivers great results, but the value for the price could definitely be better. If you have the budget for it, it's worth it, but I wish you got more wipes for what you pay!
This stuff couldn't peel a banana. Don't waste your money with this one just get the extra strength peel. My skin is looking more smother and evenly toned, it's worth a try.

This is one of my favorite skincare products in my 30s! Every time I’m regularly using it, people ask me what I’m using on my skin. I feel like my skins glows more, looks more even, and my blackheads are noticeably reduced. I am also using tretinoin, so I only use it about every 3-4 days on nights I’m skipping tretinoin. Don’t overuse or it can cause irritation.

My skin felt clean, smooth and radiant. This product is also available for oily skin as well. I tried it for the first time from a friend and had to order some for myself. I was skeptical that the product would burn or irritate my skin. I followed the directions and was pleasantly surprised! Glad I found it on Amazon!

avis.titre: Great product if you want smoother, glowing skin without going to a spa.
avis.texte: I’m honestly impressed with how quickly it works. After just a few uses, my skin looked smoother, brighter, and more even. It is a 2-step system — the first pad exfoliates and the second one helps calm and balance the skin. It gives that “fresh facial” glow at home without being too harsh. My skin feels soft and looks more radiant every time I use it. The only thing is it can feel a little tingly, so if you have sensitive skin, start slow. Also, I don’t think you need to use it every day — a couple times a week works perfectly for me.

I don't think I have ever written a review for a product in my life. I realize the lighting is different in these shots, but I didn't take a 'before' shot because I wasn't expecting to share anything with anyone. Actually, I was messaging my friend and telling her how shocked I was at these results, and I sent her these two photos this morning. So, then, I figured I should share them here because a product this good deserves some praise. One photo is of me outside a few days ago (with my natural redness—not flushed—that is just what my skin has looked like for the past 15 years or so), and then there is a photo of myself this morning, outside, after using just one of these pads. It was my first pad and my first time ever doing a peel. I used this wipe/pad last night, and when I woke up this morning, I genuinely thought my bathroom light was broken. My face looked.... so.... blue and pale?! Then, I flipped the switch on and off and realized my bathroom was fine, and my face wasn't blue. I just wasn't red anymore. I was still in shock so I went to the other bathroom and stared and stared. Are my pores smaller?! Are the little tiny warmish sun spots on my face...gone?! How did it do that?! My face wasn't even peeling or dry like I assumed it would be. Instead, it was dewy and pale. I don't think it removed any wrinkles, but it made me look like a moist newborn (with the same wrinkles??) who had never stepped into the sun.
